title: Kab Lout ke Ammu Aouge
body:
Kehti thi Sakina roo roo ker kab lout ke ammu aaouge
Kyun sogaye sahil par jaaker kab lout ke ammu aaouge
1. Sab qatl huwe koi na bacha khaimein bhi jale asbaab luta
Karte hai sitam aada mujhper - kab lout ke ammu aouge
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Is tarha tamache haye lage rukhsar huwe mere neele
Aur cheen-e-gaye kano se gouhar - kab lout ke ammu aouge
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kya hogaya dekho hum pe sitam be-parda huwe hai ahle
Haram chee-ni hai laa-ee-no ne chadar - kab lout ke ammu aouge
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Bazo hai bandhe aur sar hai khule darbaar mein hakim ke hai khade
Karte hai tamasha baniye shar - kab lout ke ammu aouge
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Kab mujhko churaa-oge bolo mar jaa-ongi ek din mein dekho
Is qaide sitam mein ghut ghut kar - kab lout ke ammu aouge
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Sahil ta qayamat ka woh sa'ma sab ahle haram they mehwe fuga
Jab kehti thi Sarwar ki duqtar - kab lout ke ammu aouge
Azz....alamdar sahil
